Name: (CP) Vanilliaish Harriet Portraits
Author: Hitme11
Description:
Portraits of your genderbend doctor, Harriet, vanilla-friendly style to play with other portraits mod. Doesn't contain her sprites or change her name in-game. Use in tandem with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url].

[b][color=#ff7700]INSTRUCTION:[/color][/b]
- Put [CP] Vanillaish Harriet into your mod folder.
﻿- That's it!

[color=#ff7700][b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][b]﻿- [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url]: tested.
﻿[b]- Other mod that change Harvey portraits: [/b]depends on what mod load first, if you use any mod that have configurations like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV[/url], I recommend to turn off Harvey changes in those mod.
